title: Akil writes the next word before it is written (crossed-out word test)

tellings.quote: it out the second it's crossed out and you start even thinking about the next one he'd start writing the next one

plain: A documentary filmmaker named Ky Dickens, who made a film about children said to read minds, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a test she says she watched around 2023 in New Jersey with a boy named Akil, with Manisha also present. She says that as soon as a word was crossed out and someone began even thinking about the next one, Akil would start writing that next word. If true, it would mean he was reading the word from someone's thoughts before it was shown.
